items.markdown:
The best area to stay in Chiang Rai depends on your travel style, with the top choices being the **Clock Tower / City Centre** , the **Night Bazaar Area** , and the **Mae Kok River**.[[1]](https://thailandwithtereza.com/where-to-stay-in-chiang-rai/)

City Centre & Clock Tower

- **Best for:** First-timers, solo travelers, and anyone without a car.
- **Vibe:** Busy, highly walkable, and practical.
- **Details:** Staying near the iconic golden Clock Tower puts you within a 5-to-10-minute walk of local cafes, massage shops, convenience stores, and budget-friendly guesthouses. It is easy to hail a ride or book transport to major sites like the White Temple (13 km south) or the Blue Temple (3 km north).[](https://www.travelfish.org/accommodation/thailand/northern_thailand/chiang_rai/chiang_rai/all) [[1]](https://www.travelfish.org/accommodation/thailand/northern_thailand/chiang_rai/chiang_rai/all)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FAHLtVvDuNw)[[3]](https://www.bonvoyagethailand.com/chiang-mai-tours/chiang-rai-white-temple-blue-temple-and-wat-huay-pla-kang/)[[4]](https://www.excursionmania.com/ttd/921/white-temple-blg-921)

Night Bazaar Area

- **Best for:** Food lovers and evening entertainment.
- **Vibe:** Lively, casual, and social.
- **Details:** Located close to the Chiang Rai Bus Terminal, this area comes alive every evening with food stalls, local souvenirs, and live acoustic music. Hostels and mid-range stays here—such as [Mercy Hostel](https://www.thelostpassport.com/top-hotels-chiang-rai/) —offer easy evening strolls without needing transport [0.15].

Mae Kok River (Riverside)

- **Best for:** Couples, families, and travelers seeking peace.
- **Vibe:** Quiet, scenic, and resort-style.
- **Details:** Situated along the Mae Kok River just a 10-to-15 minute drive north of downtown, this area hosts upscale properties like [Le Méridien Chiang Rai Resort](https://www.global-gallivanting.com/chiang-rai-travel-guide-and-itinerary/) and [The Riverie by Katathani](https://www.thailandhighlights.com/thailand/chiang-rai/hotel) . Expect large tropical gardens, big swimming pools, and quiet river views, with many resorts offering free shuttle services back into the city at night.[](https://theroamingshoes.com/2022/07/a-first-timers-guide-to-chiang-rai/) [[1]](https://theroamingshoes.com/2022/07/a-first-timers-guide-to-chiang-rai/)[[2]](https://www.thailandhighlights.com/thailand/chiang-rai/hotel)[[3]](https://www.global-gallivanting.com/chiang-rai-travel-guide-and-itinerary/)
